legacy_root.title: Specify the resume state model so a partial run is never discarded
legacy_root.question_or_target: Target: define the resumable checkpoint record (completed unit ids + receipt hashes + open nodes + param bindings) and the rule that a resume NEVER re-runs a unit whose receipt still passes the oracle. Acceptance: killing a run at 40% and resuming produces the same final artifact set as an uninterrupted run, compared by content hash.

checkpoint_record.skip_rule: A resume NEVER re-runs a unit whose live receipt still passes tools/agentspec/agentspec/oracle.py Oracle.passes. completed_unit_ids and receipt_hashes are durable evidence written after each unit; skip is decided by re-evaluating the live receipt, so a later oracle FAIL is re-dispatched (both-states control).
checkpoint_record.kill_semantics: After each unit the runner fsyncs receipt, artifacts, and checkpoint. stop_after_units implements the 40% kill point: floor(N * 0.4) durable completions, then KillAtFraction. Resume loads the same workdir and continues; it does not discard the partial artifact set.
checkpoint_record.corrupt_checkpoint: load_checkpoint raises CheckpointCorrupt when required fields are missing; the runner does not restart from zero.

evidence_anchors.claim: ResumableRunner.should_skip is Oracle.passes on the live receipt
FAIL_STATES include BLOCKED/FAILED/SEVERED/TIMEOUT; artifact hashes are load-bearing
kill-at-40% then resume hash-set equality and dispatch inequality
FAILED receipt is re-run; passing receipt is not

scope.proof_surface: Hermetic ten-unit fixture under tempfile. Kill is stop_after_units=floor(0.4*N) after a fsync'd checkpoint, not a SIGKILL of a half-written file. Oracle and runner are the live modules under tools/agentspec/agentspec/.
does_not_claim: tools/agentspec existed before this unit; oracle.py is the minimal receipt predicate resume requires
